bull_bear.body:
- Gold/precious-metal price and currency volatility — Fluctuations in gold and other precious metal prices, exchange rate volatility, inflationary pressures and changes in consumer purchasing behaviour may have a short-term impact on demand and profitability.
- Geopolitical, import-duty and regulatory policy exposure — The jewellery industry remains exposed to risks arising from global geopolitical developments and changes in import duties and government policies.
- Supply chain disruption and evolving regulatory requirements — The Company continues to monitor supply chain disruption risk and evolving regulatory requirements, adopting mitigation measures to ensure business continuity and sustainable growth.
- Channel shift to e-commerce — The rapid growth of Indian e-commerce has profoundly impacted the gold jewellery sector; consumers traditionally bought from local jewellery shops but this landscape is evolving toward more convenience-seeking, digital-age buying behaviour.

business.body: Originally incorporated in 2009 as AKM Lace and Embrotex Private Limited and listed on the BSE SME Platform in 2017, the Company changed its name over time to Aayush Art and Bullion Limited in line with its evolving business objectives and branding strategy, and now operates in the gold jewellery business. It intends to strengthen its presence across India by expanding into new and underpenetrated markets through a capital-efficient, franchise-led retail model, while also exploring select international markets including the Middle East.

outlook.body: No named plant, smelter, mine or manufacturing-capacity project with a commissioning/completion timeline is disclosed in this bundle. The growth narrative described is retail-footprint expansion — strengthening presence across India by entering new and underpenetrated markets through a capital-efficient, franchise-led store model, alongside exploration of select international markets including the Middle East, and an omnichannel push integrating physical stores with digital platforms.
outlook.title: Capex & expansion plans

outlook.body:
- Indian gold jewellery demand is supported by wedding-related cultural and sentimental value, gold's role as a reliable store of value in times of economic uncertainty, rising disposable income, and evolving fashion trends and styles
- The organised jewellery retail segment is expected to continue growing at a healthy pace, driven by increasing disposable incomes, rising demand for branded jewellery, changing consumer preferences and greater penetration of organised retail
- Growth of Indian e-commerce is shifting consumer purchasing behaviour away from traditional local jewellery shops toward more convenience-seeking, digital-age channels
- Fluctuations in gold and other precious metal prices, exchange rate volatility, inflationary pressures and changes in consumer purchasing behaviour may have a short-term impact on demand and profitability
outlook.title: Demand & outlook drivers

deepdive.thesis: Aayush Art and Bullion Limited (formerly AKM Lace and Embrotex Limited / AKM Creations Limited) is a BSE SME-listed Indian company that has rebranded from its original textile/embroidery trade into the gold jewellery and bullion business.

open.item: The Company intends to strengthen its presence across India by expanding into new and underpenetrated markets through a capital-efficient franchise-led model, while also exploring opportunities in select international markets, including the Middle East.

The Company aims to further enhance its omnichannel retail strategy by integrating physical stores with digital platforms to improve customer acquisition and retention and drive sustainable revenue growth.

The Company continues to leverage data analytics and technology-driven customer engagement initiatives to increase footfall, strengthen customer relationships, optimize inventory management, and improve overall operational efficiency.
